claim_counting: 484 claims across 9 genres: tagline, place, date_range, description, debatable, each listen_for, each hallmark, each link's label and reason (2 per link), each artist's dates, summary, 2 contributions, recording and study prompt, and each landmark recording. reacted_against is null for all 9. Unsupported means the cited sections don't say it; four place-of-birth claims are true in uncited Infobox or Early life sections and only need a citation added.
study_prompts: All 44 study prompts were checked by machine against the card: each one is the artist's summary plus contributions word for word, with the fixed opening and closing lines, so none goes beyond the card's facts. They do repeat the facts, so every fix above to a summary, contribution or recording also needs the prompt regenerated (Ron Hardy, Jeff Mills, Afrika Bambaataa, Paul van Dyk, Digital Mystikz in particular). Two print a literal '(None)'.

allegations_fairness.Derrick May: Worded as cautiously as the source: 'accused ... by several women', 'which he denies'. Pass.
allegations_fairness.Afrika Bambaataa: Less cautious than the source. The card says the allegations 'now weigh heavily on his legacy' as fact; the source gives that only as what 'others have argued' or 'said'. Fix given.

items.claim: ...DJs from the city's queer Black underground clubs began reworking disco records with drum machines to give them a harder, more mechanical pulse.
items.note: Source: DJs altered disco songs 'to give them a more mechanical beat'. 'Harder' is added.

fix.text: It grew in Chicago in the early-to-mid 1980s, when DJs from the city's queer Black underground clubs began reworking disco records, adding drum machines, to give them a more mechanical beat.

items.claim: ...and house acts like Swedish House Mafia led it.
items.note: House_music#2010s only says SHM 'showed that house could still produce chart-topping hits'. The claim is true elsewhere in the corpus (Swedish_House_Mafia#intro: 'setting the tone for the EDM boom of the early 2010s, more than any other act') but that section is not cited.

fix.text: The 2010s US 'EDM' sound was described as somewhere between electro and progressive house, and the Swedish house trio Swedish House Mafia is credited with setting the tone for the early-2010s EDM boom.

items.claim: Syncopated, polyrhythmic drum programming (patterns that push against the main pulse), which gives Detroit techno its funk.

fix.text: In Detroit techno, a basic disco beat often carries extra syncopated, polyrhythmic drum parts (patterns that push against the main pulse); that funkiness sets the Detroit strain apart.

The death date (9 April 2026) comes from the corpus intro; a human should check it.
